concatenation_order: raw bytes of /app/crate-captures/{scenario_id}.json for each scenario_id in manifest order

steps: decode capture_digest hex to 32 raw bytes as initial chain
for each scenario_id in manifest order: chain = SHA256(chain || raw scenario bytes)
emit lowercase hex of final chain

scenario_payload_len.definition: byte length of raw scenario capture file

manifest_payload_len_le.definition: uint32 little-endian encoding of manifest_payload_len as 8 lowercase hex chars

bundled_payload_len.definition: sum of scenario_payload_len for every scenario in manifest order

bundled_payload_len_le.definition: uint32 little-endian encoding of bundled_payload_len as 8 lowercase hex chars
